# Adylsha Yumayev

> Software Engineer focused on C#/.NET, backend engineering, and system design. Builds enterprise applications professionally and independent backend/infrastructure systems (identity management, real-time platforms, structured logging/observability), with 2025 training in software architecture and microservices.

## Site

- [Homepage (Turkish, default)](https://yumayev.dev/): About, work experience, projects, and skills.
- [Homepage (English)](https://yumayev.dev/en): English version of the same content.
- [Blog](https://yumayev.dev/blog): Technical notes on .NET, backend engineering, and system design.

## Notable projects

- [YumaIdentity](https://github.com/AdylshaY/YumaIdentity): Identity and Access Management (IAM) service built with ASP.NET Core, EF Core, SQL Server, JWT, and OAuth 2.0 (PKCE).
- [YumaLog](https://github.com/AdylshaY/Yumalog): Structured logging library for .NET Framework and .NET Core, built for Grafana Loki/Alloy observability pipelines.
- [YumaSnap](https://yumasnap.yumayev.dev): Real-time, QR-based event photo-sharing platform.
